name: Wand Adept (Artificer Archetype)
body:
A wand adept dedicates an immense amount of study in wands, their usage and creation.

Craft Wand

At 1st level, a wand adept gains Craft Wand as a bonus feat without needing to meet its prerequisites. This ability replaces scribe scroll.

Wand Focus (Ex)

At 1st level, a wand adept gains a +1 attack bonus with any spell cast from a wand. This ability replaces trapfinding.

Wand Quick Draw (Ex)

At 2nd level, a wand adept can draw a single wand per round as a free action. Any additional wands drawn are swift actions. However, if the wand adept has a wand belt, all wand drawing and stowing are free actions. This ability replaces the bonus item creation feat at 1st level.

Dual Wand Use (Su)

At 8th level, a wand adept can activate two wands simultaneously, assuming they are both held, as a single full-round action. Doing so is inefficient and consumes 1d4 charges from each wand. If this would consume more charges than the wand has available, it fails to activate. At 16th level, this no longer consumes more than 1 charge. This ability replaces the bonus item creation feat gained at 8th level.
